mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reminder_setting (user_id, enabled, channels, days_before_expire, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{enabled}, #{channels}, #{daysBeforeExpire}, NOW())

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reminder_setting (user_id, enabled, channels, days_before_expire, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{enabled}, #{channels}, #{daysBeforeExpire}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, channels = EXCLUDED.channels, days_before_expire = EXCLUDED.days_before_expire, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
